newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian Norma ups 10-month profit, optimistic on year.
newsitem.headline: Estonian Norma ups 10-month profit, optimistic on year.

text.p: Estonian plastics firm Norma, quoted on the secondary list of the stock market, said on Monday that its earnings for the first 10 months of the year came to 45.5 million kroons and it increased its forecast for the year.
The company said in a statement that it now expected full-year earnings of 62 million kroons, some 14 million kroons higher than its previous estimate.
It said that it was raising its estimates as its Russian market continued to be favourable.
The company said that 10-month turnover came to 333 million kroons and it expected year turnover of 408 million kroons.
